text: Bought this mechanical keyboard second hand for 38 dollars and it has been a chaotic but decent ride. The seller communication was terrible. I asked about the switch type before buying and they took a week to respond with one word. By then I had already taken the gamble and ordered it. The board is well loved. The spacebar rattles like a loose Lego brick which is incredibly annoying, and the E key sometimes repeats so I get typos like theee instead of the. But despite the quirks I really love typing on it. The tactile feedback is fantastic and its really comfortable for hammering out long painful work emails. I considered shipping it back but returning a 38 dollar heavy slab of plastic was more hassle than it was worth. So I kept it and honestly I have grown fond of its flaws. If you don't mind a little DIY tuning and the occasional double typed letter its a budget win.
